svg.aria-label: Architecture of the need-state memory: write path, the memory object, read path

g.text: the surface feeling, and each need with
text, depth 1–3, parent id, a status hint
each quote must be found verbatim in a
seeker turn; a claim left without one
hint confirmed, said this turn: confirm
parent: Analyzer's if valid, else nearest
the gap in days since the last session
Operations: the only code that writes
propose: refused without a quote, or if blocked
support: add a quote; the status stays
confirm: 2+ quotes and a yes; rivals × 0.7
disconfirm: blocked for good; its subtree goes dormant
resolve · reinstate at × 0.5 · reopen with 2+ quotes
quotes for and against, sessions seen,
half-life 14 d, × 3 once confirmed, × 1.5 for each
later session that brings it back, at most 180 d
every operation and decay step adds a row: from, to,
reason, quote, session. fold() replays it to each
node's status; pruned nodes and refusals stay in it
best guess: confirmed first, then deepest, then
the chain to it from the surface feeling
denied guesses with the seeker's words
to the Analyzer, Strategist, Generator and Critic,
L3 (naming the need) only when the best
guess is confirmed; otherwise at most L2
untested needs: tell how deep a draft goes
memory/<person>_<tag>.jsonl: the forest after each session;
this demo's rebuilt graphs match these files
